adjudication_label: batch_1:APT and EDS spectral overlaps and calibration
canonical_question: Is the EDX spectrometer colocated with the FE-SEM calibrated to distinguish between the Ti K-line and potential overlaps from other elements in the HEA?

question_variants.question: Is the EDX spectrometer colocated with the FE-SEM calibrated to distinguish between the Ti K-line and potential overlaps from other elements in the HEA?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The paper mentions an EDX spectrometer colocated with the FE-SEM but provides no details on its calibration, resolution, or ability to resolve Ti K-line overlaps with other elements.

answers.answer: The document states that chemical composition evaluation was performed using an EDX spectrometer colocated with the FE-SEM. It does not specify calibration procedures or the spectrometer's capability to distinguish Ti K-line overlaps.
answers.measurement_outcome: Chemical composition evaluated, but no calibration details provided
answers.boundary_limitation: No information on Ti K-line overlap resolution
evidence_spans: The as-cast polycrystalline sample (1.5 g) of FeCoNiTi was prepared through a homemade arc furnace.
These constituent elements were remelted several times on a water-cooled Cu hearth and flipped each time to ensure homogeneity under Ar atmosphere.
The finalization of the sample preparation involved rapid quenching on the water-cooled Cu hearth.
